story: Rank teams and compare matchups using current-season capped features, evidence shrinkage, bounded neural corrections, and post-training loss deductions.

The model retains 50% of its unshrunk performance estimate from games against rated opponents. More games reduce that shrinkage. A bounded neural adjustment refines the robust schedule rating; losses are deducted after training. Evidence retained is a model weight, not confidence in the rank. Shared weights learn from prior seasons; team reputation is excluded.

limitations: The requested cap and loss policy has lower observed 2020–2025 winner accuracy and probability quality than the previous model. Whole-game rank sensitivity is not reduced on average. Fit variation is not a confidence interval. All historical seasons were previously inspected; no independent prospective or general sportsbook superiority claim.
